title: Ignored 40 texts. Friends broke in.
caption: Ignored forty texts, so your friends let themselves in. You don't need a speech when you're hurting, you need company. Let them in, even if the kitchen is a mess and you're lying on the floor. Send this to the friends who have your spare key.
